definitions.explanation: In a decisive, unambiguous manner, often when refusing or cutting ties with something.

examples.japanese: {誘|さそ}いをきっぱり{断|ことわ}った。
{タバコ|たばこ}をきっぱりやめた。
きっぱりと「いいえ」と{言|い}った。

notes:
ONOMATOPOEIA/MIMETIC WORD:
Expresses a clean, decisive action without hesitation or ambiguity.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・きっぱり{断|ことわ}る: to flatly refuse
・きっぱりやめる: to quit decisively
・きっぱりと{言|い}う: to say clearly/firmly

SIMILAR:
・はっきり: clearly (more about clarity than decisiveness)
・すっぱり: completely, clean (more about completeness)
